summary: Li Auto Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching Next Day Disclosure Returns under Hong Kong listing rules regarding share repurchases. On July 6, 2026, the company repurchased 1,150,634 A ordinary shares at a volume-weighted average price of USD 5.9287 per share for treasury. The repurchases are disclosed under HKEX Main Board Rule 13.25A. Shares are held as treasury shares, not cancelled. This is a routine share buyback program disclosure — a capital return to shareholders via open-market purchases. No tender offer, premium, or other special-situation catalyst is present.
